title: Bhooloham
desc: Boologam and Arumugam are two famous boxers whose families are arch-rivals. Taking this into consideration, Deepak, a businessman, hatches a plan to use their rivalry to his advantage.

title: Saavi
desc: Latha, a wealthy socialite, is married to Vijaykumar, an ex-tennis player. After spotting his wife with another man, Vijaykumar makes a plan to murder her, which goes terribly wrong.

title: Kunguma Kodu
desc: A convict escapes from the police van and befriends Meena, a young girl. Later, Meena takes pity on him and brings him home.

title: Pudhiya Mannargal
desc: The lives of a young group are turned upside down when they are coerced into joining the world of politics and making a difference.

title: Chinna Jameen
desc: Rasaiya, a wealthy yet naive man, is raised by his abusive uncle, who covets his property. However, when his uncle kills Rasaiya's lover Jothi, he resolves to avenge her death.
